messages:
Jordan (PM): Quick mid-quarter async check — owners: please post 1) what shipped since the last checkpoint 2) what slipped 3) next steps/unblocks. Keep it short, aim for an EOD rollup. :wave:
Alex R: runtime: shipped model-routing-v1 to canary yesterday, rolled to prod this morning. Seeing ~12% lower median latency on long-context tests. :tada:
Alex R: CR ping — need another review on fallback-change PR #482 (main change is fallback path for OOMs). @Emily H can you nudge docs if anything changes?
Maya S: eng-platform: shipped autoscaler tuning (reduces cold starts for small bursts). Slipped: KV-cache autosave feature; blocked by storage schema compatibility.
Maya S: Next steps: storage schema PR is ready but needs infra migration window. I'll attach the schema diff in the PR. @Sanjay P tagging you for migration timing.
Sanjay P: eng-infra: we can do the DB migration Thu 18:00–18:40 UTC (30m pad). We'll run in canary then prod; expected short failover. Need explicit signoff from PMs on risk.
Sanjay P: Also FYI — we'll throttle background snapshots during the window to keep latency stable.
Emily H: devex: shipped quickstart + rollout examples for routing + canary steps (docs PR #256). Alex R, quick review would be great.
Emily H: Small config note for the autosave (for whoever picks it up):
```
cache.autosave.interval_ms: 30000
cache.autosave.batch_size: 256
```
Emily H: If schema change goes in, I'll update the quickstart with the migration steps.
Jordan (PM): Thanks — quick ownership clarifications: Alex for runtime rollout + CRs; Maya for platform features; Sanjay for infra migration; Emily for docs/devex. I'll consolidate into the Qtr OKR rollup. :memo:
Alex R: One more blocker: fallback-change PR touches the request router; rolling without extra integration tests feels risky. Proposing a short canary for 10% of traffic for 48h.
Maya S: +1 on canary. Platform can set the route weight, just need the exact time window.
Jordan (PM): Let's do canary Fri 09:00–Mon 09:00 UTC (48h). Sanjay, can infra support the extra canary?
Sanjay P: Supportable. I'll add monitoring alerts for token-level latency and error-rate during canary.
deploy-bot: Canary deployment scheduled: model-routing-v1 -> canary (10%) at 2026-03-20T09:00:00Z. Health checks: enabled.
Alex R: Great — I'll hold off wide rollout until canary looks clean. Will post a short follow-up after 6h of canary data.
Jordan (PM): Perfect. For the OKR rollup: shipped = model-routing-v1, autoscaler tuning, docs quickstart. Slipped = KV-cache autosave (blocked on schema). Next steps = infra migration Thu 18:00 UTC + canary Fri 09:00 UTC; owners named above.
Maya S: tagging action items: 1) merge schema PR once migration window confirmed 2) re-run integration tests 3) schedule autosave rollout.
Alex R: I'll queue the integration test job after schema merge. cc @Emily H for any doc changes.
Emily H: Will update PR #256 after the canary. Thx all. :thumbsup:
Jordan (PM): I'll capture this in the OKR doc and ping execs after the canary summary. If anything else comes up, add to this thread. Thanks team.
